name: Long Pause Bench Press
instructions: Unrack a barbell and lower it to your chest with control.
Pause for a full 3-5 seconds — the bar rests dead on your chest.
Press explosively to lockout without bouncing.
The extended pause builds exceptional starting strength and control.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An advanced barbell press-pattern exercise targeting the chest. Long Pause Bench Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
